headline: Gamador İnşaat Begins Construction of 48 Billion Lira Mixed Project in Ankara
summary: Gamador İnşaat AŞ has begun construction of a 48 billion lira mixed-use project in Ankara. Its chairman said housing demand around hospitals, courthouses and universities is significant, especially for small apartments.
why: Gamador İnşaat is a Turkish construction company, and large residential projects reflect demand and financing conditions in the country's property market.
